regions.region: page 3 Table 3 reaction drawing, entries 1-7, caption, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded seven independent tandem optimization/control rows. Each has a 24 h room-temperature hydrophosphinylation stage, explicit sequential addition, and a separate 24 h Heck stage at 80 °C for entry 1 or 90 °C for entries 2-7. Bracketed isolated yields and n.d. remain distinct from NMR yields.
Recorded all six scope arrows independently under the two ordered stages with absolute 1/2/4/Pd charges and isolated yields. CCDC 2417673 characterizes 5c and does not create a second reaction.

Recorded two independent post-functionalizations: Au(I)/AgOTf rearrangement 3a to furan 6 (84%, CCDC 2417670) and benzohydrazide annulation of 3b to 8 (78%, >20:1 dr). The explicit 1.2 equiv benzoyl hydrazine from the page-3/4 prose is a participant amount.
